d: FortiAP-231K Indoor Wireless AP - (Wi-Fi-7 IEEE Tri-band 2.4/5/6GHz 2+2+2 2 streams 3 radios), internal antennas, 100/1000/2500/5000 Base-T RJ45, BT/BLE, 1x RS-232 RJ45 Serial Port. Ceiling/wall mount kit included. For power order: 802.3at PoE injector GPI-130(1Gbps)/GPI-145(10Gbps) or AC adapter SP-FAP200-PA. Region Code E

specs.label: Maximum Data Rate
specs.value: Radio 1: up to 688 Mbps; Radio 2: up to 2.882 Gbps; Radio 3: up to 5.765 Gbps

specs.label: Simultaneous SSIDs
specs.value: Up to 8 per client serving radio (7 if background scanning is enabled)

specs.label: Maximum Tx Power
specs.value: 2.4GHz band: 26 dBm/400 mW (2 chains combined); 5.0GHz band: 23 dBm/200 mW (2 chains combined); 6.0GHz band: 22 dBm/158 mW (2 chains combined@320MHz BW)
